data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2044 runs from June 9 to 16 in Marbella, and the best way to elevate your fair experience is from the water. A Feria San Bernabe boat rental Marbella 2044 lets you escape the crowds, enjoy the Mediterranean, and return to the fairgrounds refreshed. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the action. Prices start at €749 for a two-hour charter, all inclusive.

Why rent a boat for Feria San Bernabe 2044?

Marbella's fair draws thousands of visitors each day. By chartering a boat, you gain a private base on the sea. Spend the morning swimming at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, then head back to Puerto Banús for the evening festivities. Our boats include a licensed skipper, so you can relax with a glass of cava while the coastline glides by.

Our fleet for Feria week

We offer 17 boats based in Puerto Banús, ranging from 6.4m speedboats to 29m luxury yachts. Here are the most popular choices for fairgoers:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – pricing on request

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Feria San Bernabe 2044 dates and times

The fair officially opens on Sunday June 9, 2044 and closes on Sunday June 16, 2044. The fairground is located along the Golden Mile, near the Marbella Arena. Daytime hours are from 12:00 to 02:00, with live music and dance performances each evening. The main fireworks display is typically on the final night.

Suggested itinerary: day at sea + Feria evening

Book a 4-hour charter starting at 15:00. Cruise from Puerto Banús toward Cabopino or Estepona, stopping for a swim at a secluded cove. Return to port by 19:00, freshen up, and walk to the fairground. You'll have time for dinner, rides, and the evening shows. For fireworks night, a 19:00–23:00 charter lets you watch the display from the bay.
